name: desktop-statusline
description: A status line for the Claude desktop app: 5-hour and weekly limits with progress bars, context, cost, and how long the 5-hour limit will last. Lay out its items over several lines with /desktop-statusline.

showInTerminal.title: Show in the terminal too
showInTerminal.description: Also draw the status line above the prompt in the terminal (it always shows in the desktop app).

percent.title: Percentages show
percent.description: used: how much of each limit is used. remaining: how much is left (the bars drain instead of fill).

display.title: Show percentages as
display.description: both: a progress bar and the percentage. bar: the bar alone. percent: the percentage alone, as text.

barWidth.title: Bar width
barWidth.description: Width of the progress bars in character cells (3 to 40).
